WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY sf.transref, tr.ordertypedist
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_shortintrt) as avg_of_avg_shortintrt
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  s1.transref,
  s1.ordertypedist,
  s1.avg_shortintrt,
  s1.avg_optvolrt,
  s1.avg_shortintrt / s2.avg_of_avg_shortintrt as ratio
FROM step1 s1
JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.ordertypedist = s2.ordertypedist
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
